visual_action: The video is a montage that intercuts clips of Donald Trump with clips of the character Lord Farquaad from the animated movie 'Shrek'. Trump is shown smiling and speaking at a rally, in front of a large crowd, and sitting at a desk in an office. Lord Farquaad is shown gesturing, looking smugly into a mirror, and addressing a crowd from a balcony. The clips are timed to the music and lyrics displayed on screen.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown in multiple clips throughout the video and is the subject of the comparison.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official '@democrats' account.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio consists of a female voice singing lyrics from the song 'How Deep Is Your Love'. The sung lyrics, which also appear on screen, include: "How deep is your love? Is it like the ocean? What devotion are you?"
audio_music: A slow, ethereal pop song ('How Deep Is Your Love' - Mitski's version) plays throughout the video. Its romantic and earnest tone creates an ironic and mocking effect when paired with the visuals of Donald Trump and Lord Farquaad.
editing_pacing: The video uses quick cuts in a montage style, alternating between clips of Donald Trump and Lord Farquaad. The edits are synchronized with the music and the appearance of on-screen text.
cultural_references: Lord Farquaad from the movie Shrek
The song 'How Deep Is Your Love' (Mitski's version)
central_claim: The video equates Donald Trump with the villainous and narcissistic cartoon character Lord Farquaad from 'Shrek', implying they are both evil.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump and encourage viewers to perceive him as a ridiculous, evil, and foolish figure.
